extensionActivated.comment: Reports coarse extension configuration at successful activation so feature adoption can be understood without workspace or process identifiers.

engine.comment: The configured debug engine: debugpy or experimental.

mcpEnabled.comment: Whether the workspace-scoped MCP endpoint is enabled.

workspaceTrusted.comment: Whether VS Code marks the current workspace as trusted.

workspaceFolderCount.comment: The number of folders open in the VS Code window.

commandInvoked.comment: Reports which fixed extension command was invoked to understand feature usage.

command.comment: One of the command identifiers declared by this extension.

commandCompleted.comment: Reports the categorical result, final funnel stage, and elapsed time of a fixed extension command without error text or user data.

command.comment: One of the command identifiers declared by this extension.

outcome.comment: A fixed outcome: succeeded, cancelled, blocked, failed, or noAction.

stage.comment: The fixed command funnel stage reached before completion.

configurationChanged.comment: Reports changes to the extension's fixed categorical and boolean feature settings.

setting.comment: One of the extension settings explicitly allowlisted for telemetry.

value.comment: A fixed boolean string or debug engine identifier.

mcpToolCompleted.comment: Reports aggregate usage and reliability of an allowlisted Django debugger MCP tool without arguments, results, references, or client identifiers.

tool.comment: One of the fixed MCP tool identifiers, or unknown after allowlist normalization.

outcome.comment: A fixed outcome: succeeded, cancelled, blocked, or failed.

durationMs.comment: Elapsed MCP tool duration in milliseconds.

hotReloadCompleted.comment: Reports aggregate hot-reload outcomes without file names, module names, paths, process identifiers, or error text.

outcome.comment: A fixed outcome: succeeded, partial, failed, skipped, timedOut, or cancelled.

fileCount.comment: Number of files in the reload batch.

durationMs.comment: Elapsed hot-reload batch duration in milliseconds.

debugSessionStarted.comment: Reports the categorical options of a Django Process Debugger session when VS Code starts it.

engine.comment: The session debug engine: debugpy or experimental.

source.comment: The fixed session entry point: command, mcp, or launchConfiguration.

hotReloadEnabled.comment: Whether hot reload is enabled for the selected engine.

justMyCode.comment: Whether the session is configured to debug only user code.

redirectOutput.comment: Whether the session redirects process output to the Debug Console.

debugSessionTerminated.comment: Reports the coarse duration of a Django Process Debugger session without sending the VS Code session identifier.

engine.comment: The session debug engine: debugpy or experimental.

source.comment: The fixed session entry point retained from session start: command, mcp, or launchConfiguration.
